entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luigi Serafini was an Italian basketball player. He was part of the Italian teams that won a bronze medal at the 1971 European championships and finished fourth in 1977. He competed at the 1972 and 1976 Olympics and finished in fourth and fifth place, respectively.
